title: JSON and CSV data

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
JSON commonly carries API objects and CSV carries table rows; CSV values are often read as strings.
CORE EXPLANATION
JSON suits nested objects; CSV suits tabular data. The json and csv modules are in the standard library; validate the format and size before processing user files.
EXAMPLE CODE
QUESTION: What will this code print? Predict first, then run it.

spans.code:
import json

payload = {'active': True, 'count': 3}
text = json.dumps(payload)
restored = json.loads(text)

spans.text: EXPECTED RESULT

spans.code: No console output; restored is {'active': True, 'count': 3}.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: JSON uses true, false, and null rather than Python's True, False, and None.
